simulated: 100 inboxes × 30/day, fully ramped · 25,001 contacts in the pipeline’s campaign × angle mix · seed 7

Case study by Bryan Soo · 27 Oct 2026

Needs a person

  • Paused: Scaling Fast × Employee RequestsBounce 7.0% on 100 sent (limit 3%). 503 contacts wait. Check the list and copy, then restart or stop.
  • Spot-check the next send wave75 rendered emails, 5 per running cell. The wave holds until approved.
  • 28 positive replies to hand offEach goes to the company’s rep, who books the meeting.

inboxes resting: 2 of 100, back on their own after 7 days. Everything else is running on its own.
